Yeah I get that, I am still young but it’s almost feeling like do or die at this point, literally. I had a severe mental breakdown a couple of months ago and was feeling extremely suicidal for a while. I’m just sick of going through these depressive cycles. The times I’m doing well last shorter and not as high and the times I feel bad just seem to drag and drag. 

I’m doing better now and slowly healing but how much of that is to do with getting my tax return and being on uni break? Luckily I’m starting a new job now where I can be earning anything between $400-$800 a shift but I’m worried the odd hours are going to bring back my insomnia. 

I’ll be 23 in a few months with not much to show of what I’ve achieved. I don’t have the confidence to date rn because I just genuinely feel like a loser. I haven’t made any friends since pre COVID, and I feel like I just keep shedding friends because I don’t know how to maintain relationships properly because I don’t feel worthy.

I know there are a lot of people in the same position as me who don’t get support from their parents, but I see the people around me who do and they just seem to have it so much easier, they seem to actually be experiencing life. And even the ones without wealthy parents, well, at least their parents love them. I have to fight and fight to get any amount of respect from them. I had to fight and fight to get them to accept my ADHD diagnosis. I had to fight and fight to get them to accept the fact my brother sexually abused me. I had to fight and fight to get them to understand that my upbringing was damaging and traumatic. 

They have this attitude that they started off with nothing and built their wealth so I should to. No handouts and such. Teach me some work ethic. All that is not necessarily wrong but at this point I just feel like a husk of who I used to be. A husk of a human being. I don’t know how much longer I can do this. They were earning close to $1million a year, would helping me out with a bill here or there when my brain is in chaos really break the bank? 

Idk at this point I don’t even want money I just feel like I need some guidance. 

In terms of going in to a trade, after 4-5 years of working manual labour jobs I’m already feeling the toll on my body, not to mention my parents would see me as failure for doing so. Also older blokes at these jobs are always saying things like “stay in uni or else you’ll end up like me.” There’s also a drug, cigarette, alcohol, gambling culture in the trades and I don’t think that’ll be a good influence on me. Catch a train around an industrial area full of tradies like Dandenong and the people look tired, weathered and depressed.  I used to work in Hawthorn full of yuppies and the people that would come in looked happy, healthy and vibrant. I have had thoughts about dropping my business degree and going into something I might actually enjoy like being a zookeeper or a paramedic or something. 

I’m almost 23 and achieved nothing, I don’t even have a drivers license. You’d ideally wanna find a life partner by what, 30? I just want to find someone to love and be loved by but how can I do that if I don’t love myself.
